#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import urlopen, Request

from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication, QMainWindow, QWidget, QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout,
    QPushButton, QLabel, QStackedWidget, QLineEdit, QListWidget,
    QSplitter, QMessageBox, QListWidgetItem, QButtonGroup
)
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QUrl, pyqtSignal, QThread

try:
    from PyQt6.QtMultimedia import QMediaPlayer, QAudioOutput
    from PyQt6.QtMultimediaWidgets import QVideoWidget
    HAS_MULTIMEDIA = True
except ImportError:
    HAS_MULTIMEDIA = False

try:
    from PyQt6.QtWebEngineWidgets import QWebEngineView
    HAS_WEBENGINE = True
except ImportError:
    HAS_WEBENGINE = False

DARK_STYLE = """
QMainWindow, QWidget { background: #121212; color: #E0E0E0; }
#Sidebar { background: #1E1E1E; border-right: 1px solid #2A2A2A; min-width: 210px; max-width: 230px; }
#BrandTitle { color: #FFB300; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; padding: 15px 10px; }
QPushButton {
    color: #E0E0E0; background: transparent; text-align: left;
    padding: 12px 15px; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; margin: 2px 8px;
}
QPushButton:hover { background: #2C2C2C; color: #FFFFFF; }
QPushButton:checked { background: #FFB300; color: #121212; font-weight: bold; }
QLineEdit {
    background: #2A2A2A; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #3A3A3A;
    border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px;
}
QListWidget { background: #1A1A1A; color: #E0E0E0; border: 1px solid #2A2A2A; border-radius: 6px; }
QListWidget::item { padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #262626; }
QListWidget::item:selected { background: #FFB300; color: #121212; }
"""

class M3ULoader(QThread):
    loaded = pyqtSignal(list)
    failed = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, source: str):
        super().__init__()
        self.source = source

    def run(self):
        try:
            if self.source.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
                req = Request(self.source, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
                with urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
                    content = resp.read().decode("utf-8", "ignore")
            else:
                content = Path(self.source).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
            
            channels = []
            cur_name = "Canal"
            for line in content.splitlines():
                line = line.strip()
                if line.startswith("#EXTINF:"):
                    parts = line.split(",", 1)
                    cur_name = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else "Canal"
                elif line and not line.startswith("#"):
                    channels.append({"name": cur_name, "url": line})
                    cur_name = "Canal"
            self.loaded.emit(channels)
        except Exception as e:
            self.failed.emit(str(e))

class SLOWebCastApp(QMainWindow):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("SLO Web Cast & IPTV Player v2.0")
        self.resize(1150, 720)
        self.setStyleSheet(DARK_STYLE)

        root = QWidget()
        self.setCentralWidget(root)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(root)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)

        sidebar = QWidget()
        sidebar.setObjectName("Sidebar")
        s_lay = QVBoxLayout(sidebar)
        brand = QLabel(" 👑 SLO Web Cast")
        brand.setObjectName("BrandTitle")
        s_lay.addWidget(brand)

        self.btn_nav = QPushButton("🌐  Navegador Web")
        self.btn_iptv = QPushButton("📺  IPTV / M3U")
        self.btn_files = QPushButton("📁  Archivos Locales")
        self.btn_cast = QPushButton("📡  Transmitir a TV")
        
        self.group = QButtonGroup(self)
        self.group.setExclusive(True)
        
        btns = [self.btn_nav, self.btn_iptv, self.btn_files, self.btn_cast]
        for i, b in enumerate(btns):
            b.setCheckable(True)
            s_lay.addWidget(b)
            self.group.addButton(b, i)

        s_lay.addStretch()
        layout.addWidget(sidebar)

        if HAS_MULTIMEDIA:
            self.player = QMediaPlayer()
            self.audio = QAudioOutput()
            self.player.setAudioOutput(self.audio)
            self.video_widget = QVideoWidget()
            self.player.setVideoOutput(self.video_widget)
        else:
            self.video_widget = QLabel("⚠️ Componente Multimedia no disponible")

        self.pages = QStackedWidget()
        self.pages.addWidget(self._create_nav_page())
        self.pages.addWidget(self._create_iptv_page())
        self.pages.addWidget(self._create_files_page())
        self.pages.addWidget(self._create_cast_page())
        layout.addWidget(self.pages, 1)

        self.group.idClicked.connect(self.pages.setCurrentIndex)
        self.btn_iptv.setChecked(True)
        self.pages.setCurrentIndex(1)

    def _create_nav_page(self):
        w = QWidget()
        l = QVBoxLayout(w)
        if HAS_WEBENGINE:
            web = QWebEngineView()
            web.setUrl(QUrl("https://duckduckgo.com"))
            l.addWidget(web)
        else:
            l.addWidget(QLabel("🌐 Navegador no disponible"))
        return w

    def _create_iptv_page(self):
        w = QWidget()
        l = QVBoxLayout(w)
        
        top = QHBoxLayout()
        self.m3u_input = QLineEdit()
        self.m3u_input.setPlaceholderText("Pega la URL de tu lista M3U aquí...")
        btn = QPushButton("Cargar Lista")
        btn.setStyleSheet("background: #FFB300; color: #121212; font-weight: bold;")
        btn.clicked.connect(self.load_m3u)
        top.addWidget(self.m3u_input)
        top.addWidget(btn)
        l.addLayout(top)

        splitter = QSplitter()
        self.channel_list = QListWidget()
        self.channel_list.itemDoubleClicked.connect(self.play_selected_channel)
        
        splitter.addWidget(self.channel_list)
        splitter.addWidget(self.video_widget)
        splitter.setSizes([350, 800])
        l.addWidget(splitter)
        return w

    def _create_files_page(self):
        w = QWidget()
        l = QVBoxLayout(w)
        l.addWidget(QLabel("📁 Archivos Locales"))
        return w

    def _create_cast_page(self):
        w = QWidget()
        l = QVBoxLayout(w)
        l.addWidget(QLabel("📡 Transmisión Local (DLNA / Xiaomi TV)"))
        return w

    def load_m3u(self):
        url = self.m3u_input.text().strip()
        if not url: return
        self.loader = M3ULoader(url)
        self.loader.loaded.connect(self.on_m3u_loaded)
        self.loader.failed.connect(lambda err: QMessageBox.warning(self, "Error", f"Error al cargar: {err}"))
        self.loader.start()

    def on_m3u_loaded(self, channels):
        self.channel_list.clear()
        for ch in channels:
            item = QListWidgetItem(ch["name"])
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, ch["url"])
            self.channel_list.addItem(item)

    def play_selected_channel(self, item):
        url = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        if url and HAS_MULTIMEDIA:
            self.player.setSource(QUrl(url))
            self.player.play()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    win = SLOWebCastApp()
    win.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())

# Plan de implementación - SLOCast v3.0

## Arquitectura

```
PC (slocast.py)
 ├── QMediaPlayer  ──────► reproduce stream IPTV en pantalla local
 ├── StreamRelayServer  ──► re-emite el mismo stream vía HTTP local
 │     puerto :8765
 └── M3ULoader (QThread) ─► carga listas M3U sin bloquear la UI

Xiaomi TV / cualquier TV o móvil
 └── conecta a http://IP_PC:8765/stream  ──► ve el mismo canal
```

## Componentes

1. **RelayHandler** - Proxea streams HTTP/HLS con reescritura de URLs HLS
2. **StreamRelayServer** - ThreadingHTTPServer en hilo daemon
3. **M3ULoader** - QThread que parsea M3U8 extrayendo name/group/url/logo
4. **PlayerControls** - Barra play/pause/stop/volumen/mute
5. **SLOCastApp** - Ventana principal con 4 páginas
